from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a5254d05.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color_cells = {}
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                color_cells.setdefault(grid[y][x], []).append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            layers = sorted(color_cells, key=lambda color: max(y for y,x in color_cells[color])-min(y for y,x in color_cells[color]) + 1 and (max(y for y,x in color_cells[color])-min(y for y,x in color_cells[color])+1)*(max(x for y,x in color_cells[color])-min(x for y,x in color_cells[color])+1), reverse=True)
            # Nested rectangular layer colors run from the largest bounding box to the smallest.
            replacement = dict(zip(layers, reversed(layers)))
            for color, cells in color_cells.items():
                for y, x in cells:
                    out[y][x] = replacement[color]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(source)
